info.title: DoubleData Static ISP API
info.description: Check organization balance, quote and order Static ISP packages, manage recurring subscriptions, list proxies, rotate selected IPs asynchronously, and manage source-IP authorization.

tags.name: Balance
tags.description: The organization USD balance shared with the DoubleData website.

tags.name: Catalog
tags.description: Static ISP tiers and cached country availability.

tags.name: Orders
tags.description: Server-priced wallet orders and asynchronous provisioning.

tags.name: Subscriptions
tags.description: Active Static ISP subscriptions and their connection records.

tags.name: IP authorization
tags.description: The source IP authorized for a subscription.

get.description: Returns the USD balance shared with the DoubleData website. Add funds on the website; the API does not provide a funding endpoint.
Returns shared, private, and dedicated tiers with cached country availability. A quote performs final live validation and authoritative pricing.

post.description: Live-validates a package and returns a short-lived, server-priced quote. This operation does not debit the organization balance.
Atomically debits the organization balance for a current quote before asynchronous proxy provisioning starts. Repeating confirmation for the same quote does not debit twice.

get.description: Returns the current provisioning state. Continue polling while status is `processing` or `outcome_unknown`.
Returns the active Static ISP subscriptions available to your organization. Each subscription includes its current rotation allowance and IP authorization.

delete.description: Disables recurring renewal at the paid-period boundary. The subscription and proxies remain available strictly through `current_period_end`. Repeating the request is safe.

get.description: Returns every proxy currently assigned to the subscription, including complete connection credentials and rotation eligibility. Treat the returned credentials as secrets.

post.description: Submits 1–100 unique active proxy IPs for asynchronous replacement. Each replacement keeps the country of its selected IP. This operation changes live production proxies. Poll the returned status URL before using replacement connection data.

get.description: Returns an accepted rotation and its ordered results. Existing rotations return HTTP 200 even when the terminal status is `partially_succeeded` or `failed`.

error.message: This proxy could not be rotated at this time. Please try again.

get.description: Returns the subscription's authorized source IP, or `null` when no IP is authorized.

put.description: Creates or replaces the subscription's authorized source IP. Sending the current value is a no-op success. This operation changes live production access.

delete.description: Removes the subscription's source-IP authorization. Repeating this operation when no IP is authorized also succeeds. This operation changes live production access.

RequestID.description: A request UUID to include when contacting support.

CacheControl.description: Responses are not stored in shared or browser caches.

Location.description: The relative status URL of the accepted asynchronous operation.

PollAfter.description: Wait at least this many seconds before the first status poll.

RateLimitRetryAfter.description: When present, wait at least this many seconds before retrying.

balance_cents.description: Available organization balance in USD cents.

status_url.description: Relative URL to poll for status. Present in the order-acceptance response.

rotations_total.description: Rotation units available for the current subscription period before use.

rotations_remaining.description: Individual IP replacements still available in the current period.

rotations_reset_at.description: When the current rotation allowance period ends.

rotation_in_progress.description: Whether a rotation is currently active for this subscription.

ip_authorization.description: The currently authorized source IP, or null.

ips.description: Unique public IPv4 addresses currently active in the subscription. Results preserve this order.

status_url.description: Relative URL to poll for status.

message.const: This proxy could not be rotated at this time. Please try again.

results.description: Ordered results corresponding to the submitted IP order. May be absent before the result mapping is available.

ip.description: The public IPv4 address to authorize.

BadRequest.description: The ID, request body, or selected IPs are invalid.

error.message: One or more IPs are not active in this subscription.

Unauthorized.description: The API key is missing, invalid, or revoked.

error.message: A valid API key is required.

PaymentRequired.description: The organization balance cannot cover the order.

error.message: The organization balance cannot cover this order. Add funds on the website and try again.

Forbidden.description: Organization verification is required for the order.

NotFound.description: The requested resource was not found.

Conflict.description: The quote expired, the request conflicts with existing state, or another subscription mutation is in progress.

TooManyRequests.description: The request rate limit or rotation allowance was reached.

InternalError.description: The request could not be completed.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The API is unavailable at the moment.
